title: Harvest Hymn
subject: English
summary: “Harvest Hymn” is a poem that celebrates the joy of harvesting crops and the hard work of farmers. It describes how farmers work in their fields throughout the year to grow food for everyone. When the crops are ready, they feel happy and thankful for nature's blessings. The poem highlights the importance of sunlight, rain, soil and the efforts of farmers in producing food. It also expresses gratitude towards the earth for giving us a good harvest. The poem teaches us that we should respect farmers, be thankful for nature and never waste food.
